# 1 - Set paths and root directory, load packages

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  janitor,
  readxl,
  rjson,
  stringr,
  data.table,
  here
)

# Set ACS / PUMS vintage
vintage <-  2023

# Set MAPC at 101 or 97 towns
# reb <- 'MAPC101'
reb <- 'MAPC97'

if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
}

root <- paste0(base,'Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

rwt.path <- paste0(root, 'Reweighter/LRTP_2028/')
mapcm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/')
swm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/')

emp_path <- paste0(root, 'Employment/')
urb.path <- paste0(root,'UrbanSim_base_pop/')
raw.path <- paste0(urb.path,'ma_state_base_data_2010_2020_v20261005/')


if (reb == 'MAPC97') {
  input_path <- paste0(swm.path, 'Output_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/SWM/')
} else {
  input_path <- paste0(mapcm.path, 'Output_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/MAPCM/')
}


#MAPC/UrbanSim Subregion Crosswalk File.
subregion_xwalk <- fread(paste0(root,'subregions_crosswalk.csv'))

mpos <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> pull(mpo) |> unique()

## turn off scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)
#Set random seed
set.seed(351)
# Helper function
sun <- function(x){sort(unique(x))}
lun <- function(x){length(unique(x))}

#Set knitr path
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rwt.path)

```

# 2 - Load and Process Reweighter Outputs

```{r}

prod.date <- Sys.Date()
# Statewide model with 97

if (reb == 'MAPC97') {
  
  swm.ctrl.pp <- data.table()
  
  for (yr in seq(2025, 2050, 5)) {
    if (yr == 2025) {
      fl <- fread(paste0(output_path, '/reweighted_PUMS_', reb, '_', yr, '.csv'))
    } else {
      fl <- fread(paste0(
        output_path,
        '/reweighted_PUMS_',
        reb,
        '_with_shelter_',
        yr,
        '.csv'
      ))
    }
    dt <- fl |>
      filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
      left_join(subregion_xwalk, by = c('mpo' = 'RPA')) |>
      rename(subregion_code = subregion_code_urbansim) |>
      mutate(
        US_AGEHHDER = case_when(
          AGEP < 15 ~ 0,
          AGEP >= 15 & AGEP <= 35 ~ 1,
          AGEP >= 36 & AGEP <= 45 ~ 2,
          AGEP >= 46 & AGEP <= 65 ~ 3,
          AGEP >= 66 & AGEP <= 75 ~ 4,
          AGEP >= 76 ~ 5
        ),
        US_HINC = case_when(
          HINCP2013 <= 35000 ~ "1",
          HINCP2013 > 35000 & HINCP2013 <= 75000 ~ "2",
          HINCP2013 > 75000 & HINCP2013 <= 125000 ~ "3",
          HINCP2013 > 125000 & HINCP2013 <= 225000 ~ "4",
          HINCP2013 > 225000 ~ "5"
        ),
        HHSize = case_when(NP == 1 ~ 1, NP == 2 ~ 2, NP == 3 ~ 3, NP >= 4 ~ 4),
        age_of_head_min = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 15,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ 75
        ),
        age_of_head_max = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 75,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        income_min = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 0,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ 225000
        ),
        income_max = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 225000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        persons_min = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, HHSize == 2 ~ 2, HHSize == 3 ~ 3, HHSize == 4 ~ 4),
        persons_max = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, HHSize == 2 ~ 2, HHSize == 3 ~ 3, HHSize == 4 ~ -1),
        children_min = case_when(children == 0 ~ 0, children > 0 ~ 1),
        children_max = case_when(children == 0 ~ 0, children > 0 ~ -1)
      ) |>
      group_by(
        year,
        subregion_code,
        age_of_head_min,
        age_of_head_max,
        income_min,
        income_max,
        persons_min,
        persons_max,
        children_min,
        children_max
      ) |>
      summarize(total_number_of_households = round(sum(new_WGTP))) |>
      ungroup() |>
      relocate(total_number_of_households, .before = age_of_head_min) |>
      setDT()
    
    swm.ctrl.pp <- rbind(swm.ctrl.pp, dt)
    rm(dt)
    gc()
    message(paste0('SWM Control Totals ', yr, ' Complete'))
  }
  
  fwrite(
    swm.ctrl.pp,
    paste0(
      output_path,
      'swm_control_totals_',
      reb,
      '_LRTP2028_',
      prod.date,
      '.csv'
    )
  )
  
}
```

#3 - Interpolate to annual control totals

## 3a - SWM - with pop correction
```{r}

reb <- 'MAPC97'
swm.10 <- fread(paste0(root,'LRTP_2023/Statewide_Control_HHds_Projections2050_MB_v04.20.23_one_year_offset_HH_Adj.csv')) |> filter(year<2020)

swm.expand.pp <- swm.ctrl.pp %>%
  select(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max,
    year,
    subregion_code
  ) |>
  group_by(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max,
    subregion_code
  ) |>
  tidyr::complete(year = tidyr::full_seq(2020:2050, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    swm.ctrl.pp,
    by = c(
      'age_of_head_min',
      'age_of_head_max',
      'income_min',
      'income_max',
      'persons_min',
      'persons_max',
      'children_min',
      'children_max',
      'year',
      'subregion_code'
    )
  ) |> rbind(swm.10)|>
  setorder(
    year,
    subregion_code,
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |> 
  group_by(
    subregion_code,
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
    ) %>%
  mutate(total_number_of_households = round(zoo::na.approx(total_number_of_households, na.rm = FALSE))) %>% 
  ungroup() |> 
  setDT()


swm.expand.pp[is.na(total_number_of_households), total_number_of_households:=0]

fwrite(swm.expand.pp, paste0(output_path,'SWM_Household_Control_Totals_SHoP_',reb,'_',scen,'_pop_corrected.csv'))


```
